name: nvjpeg_batched_ycbcr2rgb
desc: nvjpeg::batchedYCbCr2RGB_kernelv2<OutputFormat_t3 (RGB), ConvertToFormatBatchedV2, LaunchParams<32,8,16>> from libnvjpeg sm_90. Batched YCbCr -> planar RGB; each thread processes 16 output rows of one image in a batch. The conversion tail is the standard JFIF YCbCr->RGB (R=Y+1.402*(Cr-128); G=Y-0.344136*(Cb-128)-0.714136*(Cr-128); B=Y+1.772*(Cb-128); clamp[0,255]; F2I.TRUNC) -- verified identical FFMA coeffs to the ycbcr_to_rgb kernels.
kparam_abi: EIATTR_KPARAM_INFO (abs = 0x210 + Offset): Ord0 conversionBatchedParam* @0x210 (sz8); Ord1 NppiSize @0x218 (sz8); Ord2 unsigned @0x220 (sz4) = batch/column divisor UR9; Ord3 unsigned @0x224 (sz4) = UR8 batch-count bound; Ord4 bool @0x228 (sz1) = chroma-interp enable (UPRMT 0x8880).
struct_layout_decoded: conversionBatchedParam stride = 0x90 (144 bytes); param[batch] = base + batch*0x90 (batch = (blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+tid.x)/UR9, via MUFU.RCP magic-divide). Fields touched (from R2.64+off): +0x4 = width (u32, vs col), +0x8 = height (u32, vs row*16), +0xc = subsampling-mode selector (u32, drives an 8-way switch 0..7), +0x10/+0x18/+0x20 = input Y/Cb/Cr channel pointers (u64), +0x30/+0x38/+0x40 = input Y/Cb/Cr strides (u32), +0x50/+0x58/+0x60 = output R/G/B channel pointers (u64), +0x70/+0x78/+0x80 = output R/G/B strides (u32).
blocker: POINTER-TO-STRUCT param requires a fully-valid 144-byte conversionBatchedParam built in a host buffer with valid nested device pointers, strides, dims, AND a chroma-subsampling-mode byte (struct+0xc) selecting one of 8 distinct chroma-fetch/upsampling code paths. Two field-semantics ambiguities cannot be resolved from SASS alone without the struct definition: (1) whether the +0x30/0x38/0x40 and +0x70/0x78/0x80 values are byte strides or element strides, and the exact Cb/Cr pointer roles per mode; (2) the magic-divide batch indexing (Ord2 UR9 divisor / Ord3 UR8 bound) — building inputs that deterministically land on batch 0 with a known col/row mapping requires knowing the intended semantics of those two unsigned params. Even the simplest mode (struct+0xc==0) contains an inner UPRMT/c[0x228] branch doing 3:1 weighted horizontal chroma upsampling with left/right neighbor + edge handling. An INDEPENDENT, bit-faithful host reference is not reliably achievable without the conversionBatchedParam definition; building one by guessing would amount to paraphrasing the lifted IR.
